title: Unique game assignment value
statement: Let $q$ be a natural number, let $G$ be a list of unique game constraints, and let $\ell$ assign a label in $\{0,\ldots,q-1\}$ to each natural-number variable. The assignment value is the number of constraints in $G$ whose table, at the position given by the label of the right variable, contains the label of the left variable, divided by the length of $G$; a table position outside its range does not satisfy the constraint, and when $G$ is empty the value is $0$.
hypotheses_covered: A list $G$ of unique game constraints
A labeling function from natural numbers to the $q$ labels
